W.note: Very compact with clear timeline, ETA and progress bar, but no live-region announcement, no reduced-motion handling, and no next-action guidance.

X.note: Good ARIA and a restore tab, but the ETA truncates to 'Arrive...' and the tracking number wraps awkwardly, hurting the core tracking job.

Y.note: Clear status, ETA, carrier, tracking number, timeline and an explicit next-action note, with solid ARIA, live region and restore tab in a tidy dense layout.

Z.note: Polished multi-package toast with progress bar, ETA and carrier, but taller when open and the extra package tabs add bulk beyond the compact brief.
